scriptHealthBadge.reasonCrashed: Script crashed on load - check FC STATUSTEXT messages
scriptHealthBadge.reasonNoReboot: FC hasn't rebooted since install (scripts only load at boot)
scriptHealthBadge.reasonNotInstalled: Script not installed on this FC
scriptHealthBadge.runningBody: Script is running. Orbit + future commands will route through it for link-resilient execution.
scriptHealthBadge.staleBody: Heartbeat went silent. The script may have crashed, the FC may have rebooted, or the link dropped. ArduDeck falls back to native commands until heartbeat resumes.
scriptHealthBadge.title: FC-side Lua script

scriptInstallModal.connectToContinue: Connect to a flight controller to continue.
scriptInstallModal.explainerBody: Some commands aren't supported natively by every flight controller build. ArduDeck can install a small Lua script on this vehicle's SD card to add them.
scriptInstallModal.explainerTitle: Install ArduDeck commands on this vehicle
scriptInstallModal.installedParam: Possibly a parameter change (e.g. SCR_ENABLE = 1) and a reboot if scripting isn't already enabled
scriptInstallModal.installedRegistry: A registry entry on this computer tracking what was installed
scriptInstallModal.manualBody: Your flight controller's MAVLink-FTP server refused the script write. This happens on some ArduPilot builds. You can still install the script - it just takes one extra step.
scriptInstallModal.needsMavlink: Vehicle is connected via MSP. The Lua installer requires a MAVLink connection (ArduPilot).
scriptInstallModal.reviewBody: Verify the source matches the SHA256 displayed below. Resolve any blocking issues before continuing.
scriptInstallModal.safeSandboxed: Sandboxed - cannot affect stabilization, arming, or mode switching
scriptInstallModal.safeSource: You'll see the full source code and SHA256 before consenting
scriptInstallModal.safeVehicle: Runs on the vehicle, not the GCS - survives link loss
scriptInstallModal.step1Body: Save {{filename}} to your computer. The file is byte-identical to what ArduDeck would have installed automatically.
scriptInstallModal.step2Body: Copy the file to {{path}} on the FC's SD card. How you do this depends on your setup:
scriptInstallModal.step2CardReader: Pull the SD card and copy via card reader (most reliable)
scriptInstallModal.step2CreateDir: If /APM/scripts/ doesn't exist on your SD card, create it first
scriptInstallModal.step2MissionPlanner: Use Mission Planner: Config → MAVFTP → navigate to /APM/scripts/ → Upload File
scriptInstallModal.step2Title: Copy it to the flight controller
scriptInstallModal.step3Body: ArduPilot loads scripts on boot. After putting the file in place, power-cycle the FC or send a reboot command from your GCS.
scriptInstallModal.step4Body: Once the script starts running it publishes a heartbeat ({{name}}). ArduDeck listens for this and will mark Orbit as ready automatically. You don't need to reopen this dialog.
scriptInstallModal.step4Title: Come back to ArduDeck - it'll auto-detect
scriptInstallModal.successBody: ArduDeck commands are now available on this vehicle. The script publishes a heartbeat every second to confirm it's running.
scriptInstallModal.wrongBenchTest: Bench-test the installed command before trusting it in flight
scriptInstallModal.wrongExperimental: This feature is experimental. The script could fail to load, crash mid-flight, or behave unexpectedly
scriptInstallModal.wrongReboot: If SCR_ENABLE needs to change, the FC will reboot - this is refused while armed
